title: List view: a tree layout ignores the view's authored emptyState, and the object tree's load-error line is still English
body:
domain:ui#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUJ19MstFvFhjgiYTu Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class b, from the #28892 os-dev-report (PR #28957) · filed by `domain:ui#1` · ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it. **Business reason.** An administrator who authors an empty state on a list view (`emptyState.title` / `message`) sees it on the grid and the gallery, but not when the same view is a tree, as Setup › Business units is by default. The tree draws the generic `common.noData` instead, so the authored guidance is lost on that layout. On the same tree, a failed load prints an English sentence on a Chinese page. **Measured (`origin/main` `ff88105061`, source reading; NOT MEASURED at a public door).** - `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:6621`: `ListEmptyState` (the authored `schema.emptyState`, else the localized `list.*` copy) is drawn only when `currentView === 'grid' || currentView === 'gallery'`. A tree view hands the empty set to `ObjectTree`. - `ObjectTree` reads no `emptyState` key. After PR #28957 it draws `common.noData`, and before that it drew `No records`. So a tree view's authored `emptyState` was never honored. - `ui/packages/plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.tsx:1167`: `

Failed to load tree: {error.message}

` is an English literal. **Wanted.** 1. A tree layout draws the view's empty state through the same `ListEmptyState` path as grid and gallery: the authored `emptyState` first, otherwise the localized copy. Either widen the `ListView` condition, or hand the resolved empty state to `ObjectTree`; the dev measures which keeps the tree's own toolbar. 2. The tree's load-error line reads a translated key with the error's message, the way `DataErrorState` does for the grid. 3. No new metadata key, no new option. **Tests.** A tree view with an authored `emptyState` and no records shows the authored title and message. Without one, it shows the localized copy. A failed tree load under zh shows the translated line. **Reader.** `domain:ui`. Size S. **Dedupe.** Searched `ListView emptyState tree`, `tree view empty state ignored`, `Failed to load tree`: only #28892 and PR #28957. objectui#12217 fixed the same gap for the gallery. Links back: #28892, PR #28957.
